decisions.reason: As a certified near-core HVAC line with no sign of shortfall and ample slack, it is likely to be kept while its results remain uncertain.
The marine box cooler is a line extension in the marine segment with no clear underperformance, so the firm can carry it without immediate pressure to drop.
Its dedicated page suggests focused market commitment, and as an incremental marine product it is unlikely to be withdrawn after only one year.
The compact oil cooler is close to the established oil-cooling offer and shows no evidence of falling below aspirations, so retention is supported by organizational slack.
Presented on its own page and fitting the air-cooler portfolio, the finned tube is likely to be retained while its performance is still being evaluated.
Enhanced tubes are shown as a dedicated product supporting the core heat exchanger business, making early dropping unlikely given slack.
